title: Transport of the Brown principle to independent universes
statement: Fix universes u, w, v, v_H and V=max(w,v,v_H). Assume the following common-universe Brown principle: for every triangulated category A with objects in Type u and morphisms in Type V, with Type V-indexed coproducts, every homological K:A^{op}→Ab_V that preserves Type V-indexed products is naturally isomorphic to Hom_A(-,G) whenever A is compactly generated by Type V-indexed compact objects. Let C have objects in Type u, morphisms in Type v, a triangulated structure [def-weil-triangulated-category], Type V-indexed coproducts, and compact generators indexed in Type V [def-pc-compactly-generated]. If H:C^{op}→Ab_{v_H} [def-sp-abelian] is homological [def-sp-homological-functor] and preserves Type V-indexed products, then its underlying set-valued functor is representable: there exist G in C and bijections Hom_C(c,G)≃H(c), natural in c.

lean.statement:
theorem brownCohomologicalRepresentabilityUniverseTransfer
    (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ]
    [Preadditive C] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C]
    [IsTriangulated C] [HasCoproducts.{max w v vH} C]
    (hC : IsCompactlyGeneratedTriangulated.{max w v vH} C)
    (H : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{vH}) [H.IsHomological]
    (hH : ∀ I : Type (max w v vH), PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete I) H)
    (hBrown : ∀ (A : Type u) [Category.{max w v vH} A]
      [HasZeroObject A] [HasShift A ℤ] [Preadditive A]
      [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor A n).Additive] [Pretriangulated A]
      [IsTriangulated A] [HasCoproducts.{max w v vH} A],
      IsCompactlyGeneratedTriangulated.{max w v vH} A →
      ∀ (K : Aᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max w v vH}) [K.IsHomological],
      (∀ I : Type (max w v vH), PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete I) K) →
      ∃ G : A, Nonempty (K ≅ preadditiveYoneda.obj G)) :
    (H ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat).IsRepresentable
